title: 第十九章 现在的新人太厉害了第二十章 领先一个版本
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
黑塔深处。
观测间内。
“呼噜~”
尖耳女学徒娜莎盯着正在酣眠的身影，翡翠色眼眸闪过一丝难以掩饰的震惊。
刚才短短几分钟内看到的画面，给了她一次小小的冲击。
当莫宁站在那面全身镜前，开启安全储物柜的时候——
娜莎只是微微挑了挑眉，有点羡慕地咕哝道：“这小子花钱也太大手大脚了吧？”
对于当年刚刚入学的她来说，每一枚黑塔点都恨不得掰成十瓣花。
可这小子倒好，随随便便就花掉了10黑塔点。
太浪费了！
娜莎嘟了嘟嘴，心里冒出一丝不太舒服的感觉——这是一种“我当年那么苦，凭什么你这么潇洒”的微妙不平衡。
当莫宁打开安全储物柜，从里面取出那只黑色的小罐子时——
娜莎吃了一惊。
她的第一反应是：“这小子花钱也太没节制了吧？！”
连基础冥想法都没有修炼，连灵环都还没凝聚，就急吼吼地购买【宁神药膏】——她活了这么多年，还是第一次见。
你连基础冥想法都没学会，买这玩意儿干什么？
娜莎并不知道这是任务奖励。
作为监察者，她虽然可以实时观察新人的一举一动，但任务奖励属于保密信息，她的权限无法查看。
不过，她拥有另一个权力——查看购物记录。
娜莎立即伸出手，按在矗立在观测间中央的晶碑上。

她很想看看，这个挥霍无度的小子到底买了多少东西，花了多少冤枉钱。
然而，晶碑呈现的信息，让尖耳女学徒呆了一下。
【序列号7-118-256，莫宁。购物记录：无。】
什么都没有！
没有任何与【达瓦的杂货单】相关的交易信息。
那么问题来了，【宁神药膏】是怎么来的？
娜莎沉思几秒，脑海中闪过一个不可思议的念头：“该不会是额外奖励吧？”
从逻辑上来说，这是唯一的可能。
她用了好几秒，才接受了这个令人震惊的事实。
学院的考核难度极高，通过考核已经不容易，想要获得额外奖励更是难上加难。
多少学徒在学院待了大半辈子，从来没有得到过额外奖励。
而这小子第一次考核，居然就获得了额外奖励。
娜莎的嘴唇微微抿起，心里那股“不平衡”变得愈发强烈。
当莫宁为了体验魔药的效力，将药膏涂抹到眉心和两侧太阳穴时——
娜莎忍不住摇起了头：“我从没见过比这小子更浪费的家伙。”
魂淡！
连基础冥想法都没有学会，就往脸上涂抹魔药——你是为了美容吗？！
娜莎不愿意承认，这一刻她真的嫉妒了。
她嫉妒的不只是魔药，而是那种毫无心理负担的挥霍。
很快。

当莫宁开始运转【高山呼吸法】，精神严重透支，却满脸喜悦的时候——
尖耳女学徒看得一脸纳闷：“这小子在开心什么？”
明明呼吸急促，明明额头冒汗，明明看起来累得要死——他笑什么？
当莫宁疲倦到了极点，奋力爬到床铺上，秒睡的时候——
娜莎的好奇心，已然攀升到了最高点。
content_en:
Deep in the Black Tower.
Inside the observation room.
"Hulu~"
The pointed-eared female apprentice Nasha stared at the sleeping figure, her emerald eyes flashing with a hint of shock that could not be concealed.
The scene she saw in just a few minutes gave her a small shock.
When Mourning stood in front of the full-length mirror and opened the safety locker——
Nasha just raised her eyebrows slightly and muttered a little enviously: "Isn't this kid spending money too lavishly?"
For her who had just entered school that year, every black tower point she wanted to break into a ten-petal flower.
But this guy was lucky, he spent 10 black tower points casually.
What a waste!
Nasha pouted, feeling a little uncomfortable in her heart - this was a subtle imbalance of "I was so miserable back then, why are you so cool?"
When Mourning opened the safe locker and took out the small black jar——
Nasha was surprised.
Her first reaction was: "Isn't this kid spending his money too much?!"
She didn't even practice basic meditation, and even before her spiritual rings were condensed, she rushed to buy [Ningshen Ointment] - this was the first time she had seen it in so many years of life.
You haven’t even learned the basics of meditation, why would you buy this thing?
Nasha didn't know that this was a mission reward.
As a supervisor, although she can observe the newcomers' every move in real time, the mission rewards are confidential information and cannot be viewed by her permission.
However, she has another power - to view shopping records.
Nasha immediately stretched out her hand and pressed it on the crystal tablet standing in the center of the observation room.
She wanted to see how much this spendthrift boy had bought and how much money he had spent.
However, the information presented by the crystal tablet left the pointed-eared female apprentice stunned for a moment.
[Serial number 7-118-256, Mourning. Shopping record: None. 】
Nothing!
There is no transaction information related to [Dawa's Grocery List].
So the question is, where did [Ningshen Ointment] come from?
Nasha thought for a few seconds, and an incredible thought flashed through her mind: "Could it be an extra reward?"
Logically, this is the only possibility.
It took her several seconds to accept the shocking fact.
The college's assessment is extremely difficult. It is no longer easy to pass the assessment, and it is even more difficult to obtain additional rewards.
How many apprentices have stayed in the academy for most of their lives and never received any extra rewards.
And this kid actually got an extra reward in his first assessment.
Nasha pursed her lips slightly, and the "imbalance" in her heart became stronger.
When Moning applied the ointment to the center of his eyebrows and temples in order to experience the effectiveness of the potion——
Nasha couldn't help but shook her head: "I have never seen a more wasteful guy than this kid."
Soulless!
You didn't even learn basic meditation techniques, so you applied magic potion on your face - are you doing it for beauty? !
Nasha didn't want to admit that she was really jealous at this moment.
What she was jealous of was not just the potions, but the squandering without any psychological burden.
soon.
When Mourning started to use [Alpine Breathing Technique], his spirit was severely exhausted, but his face was full of joy——
The pointed-eared female apprentice looked puzzled: "What is this kid so happy about?"
He was obviously breathing rapidly, he was obviously sweating on his forehead, he obviously looked exhausted - why was he laughing?
When Mourning was extremely tired, climbed onto the bed with all his strength, and fell asleep instantly——
Nasha's curiosity has reached its highest point.
